nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

widgets_values: subject_definitions: <Picture 1> is the opening frame of this shot, a vertical 9:16 medium shot across a banquet head table, tilted down about ten degrees. <Subject 1> is Gu Xingzhou (S3) in <Picture 3>, the man around twenty-eight in a well-fitted dark suit with a straight tie and a gold wristwatch on his left wrist, seated on the left. <Subject 2> is Lin Huilan in <Picture 4>, the woman in a dark red stand-collar Chinese-style suit, at the right edge and softly out of focus. <Subject 3> is Shen Yan in <Picture 5>, the man around thirty with a short old scar at the outer end of his left eyebrow, in a worn grey-blue jacket with frayed cuffs, standing at the right rear. <Subject 4> is the red envelope in <Picture 6>: a deep red paper envelope with a creased corner, flap opened and inside empty, lying flat at the centre of the table. <Subject 5> is the banquet setting in <Picture 2>: the head tabletop, guest tables and warm overhead light from above. A deep red paper envelope with a creased corner lies open and empty on the tabletop and returns to the same spot in front of her. summary: The guest picks the empty envelope up, glances into it and puts it back where it was, saying over his shoulder that being empty proves the son-in-law has nothing to offer. retention_analysis: <Picture 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the medium framing, the downward tilt and the envelope already on the table open the shot exactly as supplied. <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - face, neat hairline, suit fit, tie and wristwatch stay identical. <Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - shoulder line and stand-collar suit stay identical. <Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - face, the eyebrow scar and the worn grey-blue jacket with frayed cuffs stay identical; he stays still and silent. <Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the deep red paper, the creased corner and the opened empty mouth stay identical; its position on the table follows this shot. <Subject 5> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - tabletop, table layout and top-light direction are kept. detailed_description: [Shot 1] From the supplied opening frame, Gu Xingzhou reaches his right hand across about half the table width, picks the deep red paper envelope with a creased corner up off the tabletop, tilts it toward his face and looks into the open mouth for about a beat. He sets it back down on the exact spot in front of Lin Huilan and draws his hand back to his own place. Through all of that he speaks slowly and smiling, one corner of his mouth lifted, stopping for a beat at the dash: <d>[Chinese] 空的也好。说明沈先生实在——实在没什么可拿出来的。</d> Neither of the others speaks while he does; Lin Huilan's and Shen Yan's lips stay closed. Meanwhile a second wave of laughter rises over the last two seconds, louder than the first. Camera: locked off, medium shot, held so the viewer sees the envelope leave and return to the same spot. No subtitles, captions or dialogue text overlays are generated at any moment in this shot. overall_soundscape: Low banquet ambience under the line, a light paper sound as he lifts and sets the envelope down, then a second wave of laughter from the room over the last two seconds, louder than the earlier one. No new music entry. non_diegetic_music: N/A
